notes:
Account history: Evaluated Redwood Hosted API Q4 2025 -> ran 2-week POC (chat + embeddings). POC summary: stable responses, saw p95 latency ~180ms for 1k token prompts; cost above expectations at scale. Business need: internal and external chat assistants, high-volume doc search (~50 qps peak), embed-based similarity for recommendations.
Procurement/legal: Legal submitted MSA and DPA redlines 2026-03-01. Key asks: 1) Limit Redwood liability to direct damages of $500k (we asked for lower cap), 2) Breach notification 72 hours (Redwood prefers 48h), 3) Customer-managed KMS and HSM options for Dedicated, 4) Data residency requirement: US only (east/us-east-1). They also asked for SOC2 Type II report and latest pentest - provided by Redwood 2026-03-03.
Technical: Want Dedicated with VPC peering and private connectivity; need network diagram and IP ranges. Target SLOs: p99 user-facing latency <250ms, 99.9% uptime for critical routes, support for quantized model variants for cost reduction. Traffic profile: 30-60 rps during peak, burst to 120 rps for marketing spikes. Wants automatic fallback to hosted-compliant model if Dedicated capacity hits limit.
Commercial: Discussed committed capacity with 12-month term for ~8 GPUs equivalent. Pricing ask: 25% discount on hosted price with guaranteed throughput SLA; Redwood proposed consumption + committed reserve model with burst credits. Finance needs unit economics and forecast to approve.
Engagement notes: AE (Maya) demoed Dedicated console 2026-02-09. SE (Ravi) ran latency tuning session 2026-02-16. Legal touchpoint 2026-03-02 (Elena led). Quote sent 2026-03-04 (drive link). Internal amberpeak champions: Daniel Wright (Platform), Priya Sharma (Security).
Stated quote: $180k ARR committed with burst add-ons; expecting final PO in April 2026.
"We like the control over routing and the KV cache behavior — but need the indemnity and data controls nailed down," — paraphrase from Daniel.
